# Taylor — MEF Twelve Lenses Reference (2026)

## Provenance identity

Internal reference for MEF's twelve lenses and sublenses, including the phenomenological and Jungian lenses and Prompt Thrownness/Geworfenheit placement.

**Local-copy state:** recovered and read in full on 2026-09-08: the twelve-lens reference, 295 lines, dated 2026-06-22. The object identifies itself as a derived synthesis reference and non-canonical compilation. It supplies the local architectural content; it does not replace the essay’s native theorem spine or the source-specific histories of its named traditions.

## Essay use

MEF is presented as the initial diaphaneity hologram/seed: a repeatable lens architecture that makes the conditions of a determination inspectable and allows an agent's objective internality to turn reflectively upon its own models.

**Claim boundary:** this document specifies the in-house architecture. Historical and disciplinary claims assigned to a lens require their own public sources; worked examples and evaluation must establish the architecture's utility beyond self-description.
